hooks.name: spec-sync (agent, spec tools)
hooks.description: Part E: after a spec tool call (IDE and CLI), keep design.md and tasks.md in step with the changed document and keep every property ID mapped to a test.

action.prompt: A spec document was just changed. Update the other documents of the same spec so they agree with it: design.md (data model, Mermaid sequence diagrams, error handling, testing strategy) and tasks.md (real dependencies only, every requirement covered by a task, every property ID has a task that writes its test). Keep every property ID mapped to a named test in docs/traceability.md. Do not weaken or drop an acceptance criterion or a property. If a change needs a threshold, stored-data or dependency decision, write the options in an ADR and ask the human.

hooks.name: spec-sync (notice, file writes)
hooks.description: Kiro Web writes specs with ordinary file tools. This command speaks only when the written path is a spec document and tells the agent what to keep in sync.
